017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.bean.jsonrpc.*;
022
023/**
024 * Shared internal plumbing for revision {@link McpRevision#dispatch} implementations.
025 *
026 * <p>
027 * Untyped-parameter coercion and typed-argument extraction. Not a general-purpose public API: the
028 * methods are {@code public} only because a revision adapter lives in a different package from this
029 * one ({@code org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20250618} vs. {@code org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp}),
030 * and Java package-private visibility does not span that boundary.
031 *
032 * <p>
033 * The {@code -32602} code these methods raise is the <b>JSON-RPC 2.0 standard</b> "Invalid params"
034 * code, not a per-revision choice, which is why it is fixed here rather than routed through
035 * {@link McpRevision#errorCode(McpErrorKind)}. A revision that needs a different code for malformed
036 * parameters must coerce parameters itself instead of using these helpers.
037 */
038public final class McpParamUtils {
039
040   private static final int CODE_INVALID_PARAMS = -32602;
041
042   private McpParamUtils() {}
043
044   /**
045    * Coerces a JSON-RPC {@code params} value to a string-keyed map.
046    *
047    * @param params The raw params value. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
048    * @return The params as a map; an empty map when {@code params} is <jk>null</jk>. Never <jk>null</jk>.
049    * @throws McpException If {@code params} is present but is not a JSON object.
050    */
051   @SuppressWarnings({
052      "unchecked" // Cast is safe: type parameter verified by MCP protocol contract.
053   })
054   public static Map<String,Object> asMap(Object params) {
055      if (params == null)
056         return Map.of();
057      if (params instanceof Map)
058         return (Map<String,Object>) params;
059      throw new McpException(CODE_INVALID_PARAMS, "Params must be an object");
060   }
061
062   /**
063    * Reads a parameter as a string.
064    *
065    * @param args The params map. Never <jk>null</jk>.
066    * @param key The parameter name.
067    * @return The value's {@code toString()}, or <jk>null</jk> if absent.
068    */
069   public static String strParam(Map<String,Object> args, String key) {
070      var v = args.get(key);
071      return v == null ? null : v.toString();
072   }
073
074   /**
075    * Reads a parameter as a nested string-keyed map.
076    *
077    * @param args The params map. Never <jk>null</jk>.
078    * @param key The parameter name.
079    * @return The nested map; an empty map when the parameter is absent. Never <jk>null</jk>.
080    * @throws McpException If the parameter is present but is not a JSON object.
081    */
082   @SuppressWarnings({
083      "unchecked" // Cast is safe: type parameter verified by MCP protocol contract.
084   })
085   public static Map<String,Object> mapParam(Map<String,Object> args, String key) {
086      var v = args.get(key);
087      if (v == null)
088         return Map.of();
089      if (v instanceof Map)
090         return (Map<String,Object>) v;
091      throw new McpException(CODE_INVALID_PARAMS, "Param '" + key + "' must be an object");
092   }
093
094   /**
095    * Reads a parameter as a string, rejecting any non-string JSON value rather than coercing it via
096    * {@code toString()}.
097    *
098    * <p>
099    * Unlike {@link #strParam(Map, String)}, which accepts any JSON scalar and stringifies it, this is for
100    * parameters whose protocol contract requires the wire value to already be a JSON string - for example a
101    * {@code completion/complete} argument value, where a numeric or boolean value must be rejected outright,
102    * not silently stringified. Shared identically by both dated {@code completion/complete} dispatch arms.
103    *
104    * @param args The params map. Never <jk>null</jk>.
105    * @param key The parameter name.
106    * @return The string value, or <jk>null</jk> if absent.
107    * @throws McpException If the parameter is present but is not a JSON string.
108    */
109   public static String strictStrParam(Map<String,Object> args, String key) {
110      var v = args.get(key);
111      if (v == null)
112         return null;
113      if (v instanceof String v2)
114         return v2;
115      throw new McpException(CODE_INVALID_PARAMS, "Param '" + key + "' must be a string");
116   }
117
118   /**
119    * Reads a parameter as a string-to-string map, rejecting any entry whose value is not a JSON string.
120    *
121    * <p>
122    * Shared identically by both dated {@code completion/complete} dispatch arms to parse
123    * {@code context.arguments}.
124    *
125    * @param args The params map. Never <jk>null</jk>.
126    * @param key The parameter name.
127    * @return The nested map with every value verified to be a string; an empty map when the parameter is
128    *    absent. Never <jk>null</jk>.
129    * @throws McpException If the parameter is present but is not a JSON object, or if any of its values is
130    *    not a JSON string.
131    */
132   public static Map<String,String> strictStrMapParam(Map<String,Object> args, String key) {
133      var nested = mapParam(args, key);
134      var result = new LinkedHashMap<String,String>();
135      for (var entry : nested.entrySet()) {
136         var value = entry.getValue();
137         if (! (value instanceof String value2))
138            throw new McpException(CODE_INVALID_PARAMS, "Param '" + key + "' values must be strings");
139         result.put(entry.getKey(), value2);
140      }
141      return result;
142   }
143}
